## What's new
- **Pages for Seerr requests** – the Requests tab now shows **30 requests per page** with a pager under the list: range (*1–30 of 245*), first / previous / next / last page and **Per page** (10, 20, 30, 50 or 100, remembered in the browser).
  - only the current page is fetched from Seerr (titles and posters included), so large request lists stay fast
  - changing the filter or the page size goes back to page 1; auto-refresh stays on the page you're on
  - the *Declined* filter is paged as well

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.10.1   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.10.0...v1.10.1
